comment: Known expected state of verification commands (tempdoc 680 environment lane; contract tightened by tempdoc 872). Consumed by the known-state-hint hook (PreToolUse Bash): when a command matches an entry's `match` regexes, the claim is surfaced BEFORE the command runs so a session recognises a pre-existing red instead of re-deriving it via stash-and-verify. A PIN IS A DATED EXCEPTION, NOT A STEADY STATE: main being red is a defect, and the pin exists only so the defect is not rediscovered while it is being fixed. DISCIPLINE: every pin carries an exit — an `exitProbe` (a command; exit 0 means the pinned red is GONE; `slow:` prefix = only run with --slow) and/or a `reviewBy` date after which the pin must be re-affirmed with evidence or deleted. `node scripts/agent-analytics/expected-state-probe.mjs --gate` fails on a pin with no exit, past reviewBy, or whose exitProbe fired. A pin whose red is gone is a lie; delete it in the fixing PR. CI runs the --gate form WITHOUT --slow, so exitProbes run only locally; the CI check is shape + reviewBy, and a pin past its reviewBy turns CI red for every PR by design.

entries.claim: `node scripts/ci/check-store-recoverability.mjs` is RED on main: "coverage: persistence write site is unclassified: modules/app-services/.../ai/install/AcquisitionStage.java". The only write the scanner sees there is Files.createDirectories(targetFile.getParent()) (AcquisitionStage.java:113), preparing the model-download directory — directory preparation for re-acquirable model blobs, not a durable store. It needs a deliberate classification in governance/store-recoverability.v1.json (nonDurableWriteSites is the likely bucket, beside TempFileManager), which belongs to PR #483's authors rather than to a guess. A failure ONLY on this line is pre-existing, not your change.

entries.claim: app-services integrationTest cases assert WALL-CLOCK budgets and spawn a real Worker, so they flake when the machine is busy (several agent worktrees building at once) — and `./gradlew build` runs integrationTest. Observed: LambdaMartBenchmarkTest's 5ms p50 threshold (seen at 5.41ms, then 8.08ms under heavier load), KnowledgeServerIntegrationTest and RichDocumentIntegrationTest (worker spawn starved: 'Timeout waiting for worker port after 30000ms', gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, 'Worker should be healthy'). Treat the SHAPE as pre-existing, not just these three names: a timeout/deadline failure here on a loaded box says nothing about the property asserted. Re-run with --tests to confirm.

entries.claim: `node scripts/docs/docs-validate.mjs` exits 1 REPO-WIDE: 6751 `heading-case` findings across docs/, plus per-file `[tags] Few tags (0)`, `[aliases] Few aliases (0)` and `[heading] H1 does not match front matter title` advisories. It is not wired into CI and is not a pre-merge gate for any subject in CLAUDE.md's table, so editing a canonical doc does not make its red yours. A docs-validate failure is only yours if it names a heading or frontmatter key your diff actually touched.
